title: Heart Sutra
speaker: Red Pine
summary: The talk's main teaching is that true freedom and awakening come not from intellectual understanding or emotional transformation alone, but from transcending our conceptual thinking and ego boundaries. By letting go of our attachments to things and ourselves, we can see through the illusion of separation and discover a deeper unity and interconnectedness with all phenomena. This allows us to experience reality in its pure form, unfiltered by our dualistic perceptions, and ultimately reveals our true nature as it is.
